newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-TILLEKERATNE CENTURY GIVES SRI LANKA THE EDGE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-TILLEKERATNE CENTURY GIVES SRI LANKA THE EDGE.

text.p: A patient century by Hashan Tillekeratne put Sri Lanka in a comfortable position against Pakistan at lunch on the second day of the first test at the R. Premadasa stadium on Sunday.
Sri Lanka went to lunch on 319 for seven with Tillekeratne unbeaten on 101 and Chaminda Vaas on 17.
Tillekeratne's sixth test century came shortly before lunch off 215 balls in 325 minutes and included 10 boundaries. It was his second century against Pakistan.
His previous century against Pakistan was at Faisalabad during the 1995-96 tour when he hit 115 to earn Sri Lanka a victory.
Sri Lanka lost two wickets in the morning session -- Romesh Kaluwitharana for 57 and Kumar Dharmasena for one. Both men fell to off-spinner Saqlain Mushtaq.
Kaluwitharana hit eight fours during his 106-minute stay which produced 89 runs for the sixth wicket partnership with Tillekeratne.
Scores: Sri Lanka 319 for 7 at lunch (A.Ranatunga 49, H.Tillekeratne 101 not out, R. Kaluwitharana 57; Saqlain Mushtaq 3 for 89, Mushtaq Ahmed 3 for 123).
